# ABI PIN for building the oMLX GLM DSA native kernels (_ext).
# The nanobind used to build _ext MUST match the nanobind that the installed `mlx` wheel was built against,
# or mlx::core::array is a different C++ type across the module boundary and every native call raises
# `TypeError: incompatible function arguments` (silent fallback to pure-MLX = zero speedup).
# mlx bundles nanobind v2.12.0 (mlx's CMakeLists: GIT_TAG v2.12.0). Install BEFORE cmake configure:
#     pip install --no-deps -r nanobind-pin.txt
# and never `pip install -U` it past 2.12.0 without rebuilding _ext against the new mlx.
nanobind==2.12.0
